labeler: prompt_subagents:haiku (one labeling subagent per batch, acordaos first)
notes: Seed gold built the subagent way: strict sampling (acordao requires ACORDAO+VOTO+ACORDAM, sentenca requires SENTENCA+dispositivo-formula+operative-verb; despachos excluded), Haiku labeling subagents returning {category,match,nth}, offsets resolved by opf_annotate from-spans, overlaps removed deterministically, then a decorrelated 4-role Sonnet ensemble over val+test. ref_normativa is intentionally NOT labeled (regex pre-pass at inference). Expanded from single-tribunal (TJRO) to 6 tribunals (TJRO, TJRJ, TRF4, TJAM, TJSC, TJBA); 58 docs total. G1-G5 gates not yet met (target: 150 docs).
